name: Submit new sitemap URLs to IndexNow and send Telegram alerts

parameters.content:
## Submit new sitemap URLs to IndexNow and send Telegram alerts

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning, loads your configuration values, fetches your XML sitemap, and detects URLs that have not been seen before. When new URLs are found, it submits them to the IndexNow API so Bing and other IndexNow search engines crawl them quickly, then sends a Telegram alert listing the new pages.

The first run only saves a baseline: nothing is submitted and you receive a confirmation message.

### Setup steps

- Generate an IndexNow key and host the key file at the root of your site.
- Open the "Set Sitemap Configurations" node and fill in sitemapUrl, the optional urlFilter, siteHost, indexNowKey, indexNowKeyLocation and telegramChatId.
- Connect your Telegram credentials in the "Send Telegram Notification" node.
- Activate the workflow. Known URLs are stored in workflow static data, which is only saved when the workflow is active.

### Customization

- Set urlFilter to "/blog" to watch only blog posts, or leave it empty to watch the whole site.
- Change the schedule, the Telegram message text, or replace Telegram with Slack or email.
- The workflow reads one sitemap file. If you use a sitemap index, point it to the child sitemap you want to watch.

## Schedule and configure

Starts the workflow on a morning schedule and defines the sitemap, host, filtering, and IndexNow key values used downstream.

## Fetch and detect URLs

Retrieves the configured sitemap and compares its URLs against stored history to return only newly discovered URLs.

## Submit and alert

Checks whether there are new URLs to process, submits them to IndexNow when present, and sends a Telegram notification from either the decision path or after submission.
